item.description: Today, Colorado gubernatorial candidate Michael Bennet announced his Build for the Future Agenda, a comprehensive plan to ensure Colorado’s growth is healthy, sustainable, and affordable by expanding housing supply, modernizing transportation, and investing in clean, reliable energy.
